Name: Haley 8-Heart Event - Updated Photos
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
[b]Update:[/b] Haley is now wearing her winter outfit! Plus, the cow has her tiny horns back.

It's a tiny issue, but it bothers me that the "photos" in Haley's 8-heart event don't match anything from the area you're in when it starts. So, I've updated the image to match the current game art, and to reflect what was seen in the heart event. The only thing that changes is the photos that are shown after the interactions with Haley.

Downloads.Description:
Includes photos for all seasons. Plus, the cow actually has her tiny horns back (unlike the files in V1.2).

Updated because I forgot a bloody comma in the bloody manifest file.
